question: Return the full name and id of the actor or actress who starred in the greatest number of films.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.first_name ,  T2.last_name ,  T2.actor_id FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS T1 JOIN sakila_1_actor AS T2 ON T1.actor_id  =  T2.actor_id GROUP BY T2.actor_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH actor_film_counts AS (
    SELECT
        fa.actor_id,
        COUNT(*) AS film_count
    FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS fa
    GROUP BY fa.actor_id
),
max_film_count AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(film_count) AS max_count
    FROM actor_film_counts
)
SELECT
    a.actor_id AS actor_id,
    a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS full_name
FROM actor_film_counts AS afc
JOIN max_film_count AS mfc
    ON afc.film_count = mfc.max_count
JOIN sakila_1_actor AS a
    ON afc.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY
    a.actor_id;

question: Which film has the most number of actors or actresses? List the film name, film id and description.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.title ,  T2.film_id ,  T2.description FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS T1 JOIN sakila_1_film AS T2 ON T1.film_id  =  T2.film_id GROUP BY T2.film_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

ranked_films AS (

question: Which film has the most copies in the inventory? List both title and id.

question: What is the full name and id of the customer who has the lowest total amount of payment?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.customer_id FROM sakila_1_customer AS T1 JOIN sakila_1_payment AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.customer_id ORDER BY sum(amount) ASC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH payment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_payment_amount
    FROM sakila_1_payment
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
min_total AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(total_payment_amount) AS lowest_total_payment_amount
    FROM payment_totals
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM payment_totals pt
JOIN min_total mt
    ON pt.total_payment_amount = mt.lowest_total_payment_amount
JOIN sakila_1_customer c
    ON pt.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY
    c.customer_id;

question: Which transportation method is used the most often to get to tourist attractions?
gold_sql: SELECT How_to_Get_There FROM cre_Theme_park_Tourist_Attractions GROUP BY How_to_Get_There ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH transportation_counts AS (
    SELECT
        How_to_Get_There AS transportation_method,
        COUNT(*) AS attraction_count
    FROM cre_Theme_park_Tourist_Attractions
    WHERE How_to_Get_There IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY How_to_Get_There
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(attraction_count) AS max_attraction_count
    FROM transportation_counts
)
SELECT
    tc.transportation_method AS transportation_method,
    tc.attraction_count AS attraction_count
FROM transportation_counts AS tc
JOIN max_count AS mc
    ON tc.attraction_count = mc.max_attraction_count
ORDER BY
    tc.transportation_method;
